messages.subject: Rattle Combo Box
parts:
Hello There,
 
I added a combo box on Rattle with the following piece of code:
 
update_continuous_variable <- function(action, window)                         
{                                                                              
  vl <- unlist(sapply(colnames(crs$dataset),                                   
                      function(x)                                              
                      {                                                        
                        cmd <- sprintf("is.integer(%s)", x)                    
                        var <- try(ifelse(eval(parse(text=cmd), crs$dataset),  
                                          x, NULL), silent=TRUE)               
                        if (inherits(var, "try-error"))                        
                          var <- NULL                                          
                        return(var)                                            
                      }))                                                      
  if (! is.null(vl))                                                           
  {                                                                            
    action$getModel()$clear()                                                  
    lapply(vl, action$appendText)                                              
  }                                                                            
}
 
However, whenever I leave focus from the combo box, the selection in the box will be cleared.  What I missed in the code?
 
In general, where I could locate more information on Glade-RGtk2 to learn the coding in Rattle?
 
Many Thanks!
Marco LO

Nothing sticks out as a problem. Your code is probably modelled on
update_comboboxentry_with_dataframes. Do you see the same behaviour
with that combobox?

> In general, where I could locate more information on Glade-RGtk2 to
> learn the coding in Rattle?

Unfortunately there is next to nothing specific to RGtk. But it is a
direct mapping of the GTK and Glade libraries, so the general GTK and
Glade API docs can help, but it is not always easy.

Regards,
Graham

Hi Marco,

I had a bit of a look to find that the problem also exists with my
current rdataset_combobox. I think a simple solution is as below -
cechk what the current selected value is, and after updating the
combobox on the next focus change, return to that selection.

The code is:

========================================================================
update_comboboxentry_with_dataframes <- function(action, window)
{
current <- rattleWidget("rdataset_combobox")$getActiveText()

dl <- unlist(sapply(ls(sys.frame(0)),
function(x)
{
cmd <- sprintf("is.data.frame(%s)", x)
var <- try(ifelse(eval(parse(text=cmd),
sys.frame(0)),

x, NULL), silent=TRUE)
if (inherits(var, "try-error"))
var <- NULL
return(var)
}))

if (! is.null(dl))
{
action$getModel()$clear()
lapply(dl, action$appendText)
## Set the selection to that which was already selected, if
possible.
if (! is.null(current) && is.element(current, dl))
action$setActive(which(sapply(dl, function(x) x==current))[1]-1)
}
}
